finalText:
**380 commits, 3 that break callers.** Draft is in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).

The breaking ones are all labeled `refactor` or `fix`, so they hide in the sheet. `stop re-exporting the internal error types` removes public exports across five modules. `drop the unused v1 export route` removes a route. `return 401 for an expired token instead of 403` changes a status code.

One real feature: webhook retry with backoff. Nine distinct bug fixes. The rest is deps, tests, and CI.

Two calls to check. I put the perf work under `Added` since the shape has no perf heading. And `docs: note the minimum node version` never touched `engines` in `package.json`, so I left it out.
